main.description: A file or folder in a drive. The record key is its permanent ID: renames and moves update the record, never the key. Stored plain on a drive that isn't encrypted: the fields below, as they are. Stored sealed on an encrypted drive: only chunks (the blob refs, which the PDS needs to keep the blobs) and sealed, which holds every other field. A reader tells the two apart by whether sealed is there, and a drive being converted holds both.

parent.description: The folder's record key. Absent at the top level.

sha256.description: Files: SHA-256 of the whole file, in hex.

chunks.description: Files: the contents, in chunks, in order: the file's bytes on a plain drive, ciphertext on an encrypted one. Absent when they're in chunks records (continuations).

chunkIDs.description: The IDs that decrypt the chunks, in the same order (32 bytes each, base64 without padding). Absent when the chunks are plain. In a plain record they're readable, so the chunks are too: that only happens after encryption was turned off.

chunkKey.description: The key ID of the drive key the chunk IDs were made with.

modifiedAt.description: Files: the file's own modification time.

version.description: The record key of the node's current version.

contentsFrom.description: Files: the record key of the version that holds these chunks.

continuations.description: Files: how many me.jsnelgro.atdrive.chunks records hold the chunk list, when it's too long for one record. The record then has neither chunks nor chunkIDs.

continuationsFrom.description: The number of the first of those records, when it isn't 1.

sealed.description: On an encrypted drive: every other field, as a JSON object, sealed for this space, collection and record key. The record then has only this and chunks.

mount.description: Mounts: the space that appears here.
